CONTROL: schema_similar is run as the mirror. If BOTH beat random by the same margin then the effect is 'selecting on schema at all' rather than complementarity, which would be a different and much weaker claim. On mimic4_sites the R86 gradient REVERSES (care units inside one hospital, not separate institutions), so schema_complement should be no better or worse there -- that is the negative control that distinguishes a real mechanism from a fitting artefact.
